notes.title: One Day More passes Intel review
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
We have a great reason to talk with you.

The game should be balanced between colorful pictures and high speed of playing. Thanks to Intel! They gave us the opportunity to test our game and we showed a good result.

One Day More passed with no issues to the quality program of Intel. The game is playable on new mainstream integrated Intel XE Intel Iris Xe Graphics G7. It means our programists and UE artists created a quality product, which will be a pleasure to play. 

Remind you of the game release plan to be this Summer! 
Follow the news.

[url=https://devmesh.intel.com/projects/one-day-more#about-section]One Day More on Intel website [/url]

[previewyoutube=7oQ47gRR18o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Stream with developers!
notes.content:
One Day More for the Media Indie Exchange

We’ll tell you about events of the last festival #MIXNext from the horse mouth.
Even though it's not the first showcase, we were excited to get the feedback.

On the 13th of November we showed updated gameplay so the players from all over the world could meet Hannah and add our game to their wishlist on Steam!

We appreciate your choice! It means we crunched for a reason ❤️ 
You can see the full version of fun and relaxing gameplay on YouTube.

Devs commented with love and were surprised of a few new bugs 😅
Comment below your thoughts and advice ☺️

notes.title: The first live demo of One Day More!
notes.content:
The first live demo of the bright adventure One Day More as part of the “Next fest”.
Meet Hannah and help her solve her first puzzles!

Hannah is a modern girl who wants to make music. But she can’t get any understanding or support from her parents.

One day Hannah puts on her favorite music and the world around her starts changing rapidly! And so do her skills - they grow with each new turn of the skateboard wheels. But you need to be careful - fears and stereotypes imposed by society haunt her even here.

Will Hannah be able to avoid getting lost in her own fantasies, gain confidence and make her dream of playing music come true?

This is for you to decide!

[b]Features and capabilities of One Day More[/b]

[list][*]Rich visuals in the Supremacist style 
[*]Exploring the relevant topic of self-realization 
[*]Stylized puzzles of various complexity 
[*]Traditional platform views: side and third-person
[*]The ability to explore various locations by riding a skateboard around them
[*]The ability to collect original achievements 
[*]The ability to ride a skateboard on the ceiling[/list]
